T5_PROXIMITY: STOP. Person close to the machine.
T5_SLOPE: STOP. Slope too steep. Lower the bucket.
T5_RISK: STOP. Hold position and look around.
T4_HOTZONE: Crew area close. Slow to walking pace.
T4_SEATBELT: Seatbelt is off. Buckle up before moving.
T4_SMOOTH: Ease off the controls. Movements are getting sharp.
T4_FATIGUE: Take a ten-minute break at the next stop.
T4_VISIBILITY: Low visibility. Slow down and use the camera.
T4_SLOPE: Ground is getting steep. Keep the load low.
T4_HYD_HOT: Hydraulics running hot. Ease the load for five minutes.
T4_RISK_RISING: Risk is rising. Slow down and check around you.
T4_TASK_DELAY: Task running long. Foreman knows. Keep a safe pace.
